home.heroTitle: One membership. Gyms and studios across Tashkent.
home.heroSubtitle: Find partner gyms, pools, and studios, book a session in a few taps, and check in with a QR code.
home.step1Text: Pick a monthly visit allowance that fits your routine. Each plan lists exactly which venues it includes.
home.step2Text: Reserve a class or an open-gym time up to a week ahead. Cancel in time and the visit returns to your balance.
home.step3Text: Open your check-in code at the venue. Reception scans it and your visit is recorded.
home.plansText: Compare visit allowances, booking rules, and included venues before you choose.
home.sampleNotice: Prices shown are samples for the demo.
